en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is an ornate metal bridge with decorative lampposts and pedestrians walking along the embankment. Across the river stand multi‑story townhouses and a church tower with a green onion dome and clock. In the background, a wooded hill rises with fortification buildings on top and a distinctive clock tower on the slope. The printed caption at the top left reads "Graz. Schlossberg."
